features.name: credit_amount_per_month
features.description: Calculates the theoretical monthly principal payment by dividing the total credit amount by the duration in months.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a continuous ratio representing monthly financial burden, allowing the linear model to capture the interaction between loan size and term length directly.

features.name: age_normalized
features.description: Min-max normalization of the applicant's age based on the training set minimum (19) and maximum (75).
features.expected_model_benefit: Scales age to a [0, 1] range, preventing this feature from dominating the SVM margin calculation due to its naturally larger scale compared to categorical encodings.

features.name: duration_normalized
features.description: Min-max normalization of the loan duration based on the training set minimum (4) and maximum (72).
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes the loan duration, ensuring the linear SVM treats time-based risk on a comparable scale to other normalized features.

features.name: financial_stability_score
features.description: A continuous score assessing the applicant's financial reserves and income stability based on checking_status, savings_status, and employment duration. Higher values indicate greater financial stability.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a single, continuous linear projection of multiple categorical financial indicators, simplifying the feature space and improving margin separation.

features.name: installment_burden
features.description: Scales the installment commitment rate (1 to 4) into a continuous fraction.
features.expected_model_benefit: Transforms an ordinal commitment scale into a continuous fraction, suitable for linear weighting in the SVM decision function.

features.name: credit_history_severity
features.description: A continuous severity measure of past credit behavior based on credit_history, where 0.0 represents perfect history ('all paid') and 1.0 represents severe issues ('critical/other existing credit' or 'delayed previously').
features.expected_model_benefit: Maps complex categorical credit history states into a monotonic severity score, allowing the linear model to assign a single, interpretable weight to past credit behavior.

features.name: log_credit_amount
features.description: Applies a logarithmic transformation to the credit amount to reduce the impact of extreme high-value loans.
features.expected_model_benefit: Applies a logarithmic transformation to a heavily skewed monetary variable, linearizing its relationship with risk and stabilizing the SVM margin.

features.name: property_and_housing_strength
features.description: An assessment of asset ownership and living situation stability based on property_magnitude and housing. Higher values indicate stronger asset backing (e.g., owning real estate).
features.expected_model_benefit: Combines property and housing categories into a continuous asset-strength dimension, providing a smooth gradient for the linear classifier to separate risk profiles.

features.name: credit_to_age_ratio
features.description: Calculates the ratio of the requested credit amount to the applicant's age.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the interaction between requested credit and applicant age as a continuous ratio, exposing a potentially non-linear relationship in a linearly separable format.

features.name: employment_stability_index
features.description: A composite index evaluating the applicant's job security and skill level based on employment duration and job type. Higher values indicate long-term, highly skilled employment.
features.expected_model_benefit: Translates categorical employment duration and job type into a continuous stability metric, reducing dimensionality and aiding linear separability.

features.name: existing_credits_normalized
features.description: Min-max normalization of the number of existing credits based on the training set minimum (1) and maximum (4).
features.expected_model_benefit: Scales the count of existing credits to a standard [0, 1] interval, ensuring consistent gradient updates and margin scaling in the SVM.

features.name: social_support_network
features.description: An evaluation of the applicant's social and familial support structure based on personal_status, other_parties (e.g., guarantor), and num_dependents. Higher values indicate a stronger support network.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates personal status, dependents, and guarantors into a continuous support score, offering a unified linear feature that represents social stability.
